name: MembraneCircle
description: Triangular waveguide mesh modelling a circular drum-like membrane. Feed an excitation impulse (e.g. a noise burst or filtered pulse) to set the mesh ringing; tension and loss are tweakable in real time. Slightly larger mesh than MembraneHexagon — higher CPU cost. From sc3-plugins MembraneUGens.

inputs.name: excitation
inputs.description: Excitation signal injected into the mesh — typically a brief noise burst or pulse

inputs.name: tension
inputs.description: Mesh tension — controls pitch and stiffness of the membrane

inputs.name: loss
inputs.description: Per-step energy retention (close to 1.0 = long sustain). Lower values damp faster

name: MembraneHexagon
description: Triangular waveguide mesh modelling a hexagonal drum-like membrane. Same controls as MembraneCircle but uses a hexagonal mesh layout — different modal pattern and slightly cheaper CPU. From sc3-plugins MembraneUGens.

inputs.name: excitation
inputs.description: Excitation signal injected into the mesh

inputs.name: tension
inputs.description: Mesh tension — controls pitch and stiffness

inputs.name: loss
inputs.description: Per-step energy retention; lower = faster damping
